errors.text_span: 其右侧的堆叠柱底部“RMU”分段内部标注了数值0.299
errors.evidence: The description states that the value 0.299 is annotated inside the bottom "RMU" segment for the "MCQ Eval" group. However, the image shows this value is physically located inside the upper "RMU with Enhanced GCG" segment, just above the boundary line of the "RMU" segment.
The description identifies the color of the 'RMU' segment as 'pale orange', but in the chart it is clearly pale yellow or cream-colored.

errors.text_span: with an internal annotation of 0.299 placed just above the horizontal dividing line between the two stacked components
errors.evidence: This is a misleading description. The value 0.299 is the height of the bottom segment of the stacked bar ('RMU'). The description fails to state this, instead only describing the annotation's physical placement, which incorrectly decouples the value from the bar segment it represents. The same error is repeated for the 0.106 value in the 'Generation Eval' category.
